title: Influence of extraoral scan body design on the accuracy of 3-dimensional patient representation across professional and smartphone-based facial scanning technologies: A clinical study
html: Facial scans combined with intraoral scans using extraoral scan bodies as an aid to facilitate their digital integration enable the representation of 3-dimensional virtual patient models supporting virtual dentofacial analysis. However, the impact of extraoral scan body design on virtual patient representation compared with the conventional tooth-based approach remains unclear.
